# Scrolly

> Scrolly (https://scrolly.live) is a free bilingual (English and Turkish) reels-style micro-learning Progressive Web App (PWA) delivering daily curated science, space, history, nature, human body, weird records, and statistics facts backed by primary sources. Every vertical card combines a direct BLUF summary, an interactive Quick Guess slider, a deeper "Why / How?" breakdown, B1–C2 Word Lab vocabulary training, Quiz Hub recall tests, and Scrolla 1v1 live multiplayer trivia duels.

> Scrolly (https://scrolly.live); uzay, doğa, insan vücudu, tarih, bilim, garip rekorlar ve istatistik alanlarında birincil bilimsel kaynaklarla doğrulanmış günlük mikro-öğrenme kartları, etkileşimli Hızlı Tahmin oyunu, B1–C2 Word Lab İngilizce kelime laboratuvarı, Quiz Merkezi ve Scrolla 1v1 canlı bilgi düelloları sunan ücretsiz, iki dilli (TR/EN) bir PWA platformudur.

## Core Pages

- [Scrolly Interactive Feed (TR)](https://scrolly.live/): Main Turkish reels-style micro-learning feed with Quick Guess challenges, primary source links, and XP progression.
- [Scrolly Interactive Feed (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en): Full English-language discovery feed with verified scientific citations, Quick Guess sliders, and memory quizzes.
- [Quiz Hub (Daily Sprint, Weekly Marathon & Memory Quiz)](https://scrolly.live/?tab=quiz): 5-card Memory Quiz from recently viewed cards, Daily Sprint, 10-question Weekly Marathon, and Word Lab quiz modes.
- [Scrolla 1v1 Live Trivia Arena](https://scrolly.live/?tab=duel): Real-time two-player head-to-head knowledge duel rooms with 6-character room codes, topic filtering, and synchronized timers.
- [Explorer Leaderboard](https://scrolly.live/?tab=leaderboard): Live daily, weekly, and all-time XP rankings and Explorer League standings.
- [Full Verified Knowledge Corpus (llms-full.txt)](https://scrolly.live/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-text Markdown export of Scrolly's editorial methodology, FAQ, and bilingual verified fact cards with primary source URLs.
- [XML Sitemap](https://scrolly.live/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of all bilingual homepage, topic archive, policy, and individual `/fact/[slug]` and `/en/fact/[slug]` URLs.

## Topics & Categories

- [Space Facts Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/space): Verified astronomy, astrophysics, exoplanets, black holes, and NASA/ESA mission discoveries.
- [Uzay Bilgi Kartları Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/space): Kara delikler, ötegezegenler, kozmoloji ve uzay görevlerine dair doğrulanmış bilgi kartları.
- [Nature Facts Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/nature): Animal biology, deep-ocean ecosystems, botany, evolutionary adaptations, and Earth phenomena.
- [Doğa Bilgi Kartları Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/nature): Hayvan biyolojisi, okyanus ekosistemleri, botanik ve doğadaki hayatta kalma stratejileri.
- [Human Body Facts Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/human-body): Neuroscience, cardiology, genetics, physiology, sensory perception, and medical science facts.
- [İnsan Vücudu Bilgi Kartları Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/human-body): Nörobilim, fizyoloji, genetik ve insan anatomisine dair bilimsel bilgi kartları.
- [History Facts Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/history): Ancient civilizations, archaeological discoveries, surprising inventions, and documented world history.
- [Tarih Bilgi Kartları Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/history): Kadim uygarlıklar, arkeolojik keşifler, tarihsel icatlar ve belgelenmiş dünya tarihi.
- [Science Facts Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/science): Quantum physics, chemistry, thermodynamics, materials science, and peer-reviewed laboratory breakthroughs.
- [Bilim Bilgi Kartları Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/science): Kuantum fiziği, kimya, termodinamik ve temel bilim keşifleri.
- [Weird Records Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/records): Documented Guinness extremes, extraordinary natural anomalies, and verified scientific oddities.
- [Garip Rekorlar Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/records): Guinness ve akademik kayıtlarla belgelenmiş sıra dışı dünya rekorları.
- [Statistics & Probability Archive (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en/category/statistics): Counterintuitive probability paradoxes, Bayes theorem, survivorship bias, and data-backed insights.
- [İstatistik ve Olasılık Arşivi (TR)](https://scrolly.live/category/statistics): Olasılık paradoksları, veri yanılsamaları ve şaşırtıcı istatistiksel gerçekler.
- [Word Lab B1–C2 Vocabulary Feed](https://scrolly.live/?category=vocabulary): Bilingual B1–C2 English vocabulary cards with IPA pronunciation, normal/slow audio, context sentences, and meaning quizzes.

## Policies & Contact

- [About Scrolly & Editorial Methodology](https://scrolly.live/about): Primary source verification workflow, bilingual editorial standards, and Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ).
- [Contact & Source Corrections](https://scrolly.live/contact): Official editorial desk (`contact@scrolly.live`) for source corrections, feedback, and inquiries.
- [Privacy & Cookie Policy](https://scrolly.live/privacy): Anonymous guest local storage, optional passwordless email OTP sync, offline PWA caching, analytics, and Google AdSense disclosures.
- [Terms of Use & Educational Disclaimer](https://scrolly.live/terms): Service terms, educational content disclaimer, intellectual property notice, and fair-use rules.
